definitions.meaning: A prayer asking for something (evil) to come upon a person, an imprecation

quotations.old_english: Hí ús mid heora wiðerwordum onbénum and wyrinessum éhtaþ

source_text: on-bén, e; f. A prayer asking for something (evil) to come upon a person, an imprecation :-- Hí ús mid heora wiðerwordum onbénum and wyrinessum éhtaþ qui adversis nos imprecationibus persequuntur, Bd. 2, 2; S. 504, 4.
